subject: Vendor onboarding: payflow alignment and Net-term bridge plan
messages:
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@aurorahealth.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@aurorahealth.com
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: New vendor onboarding — payment timing and early-pay request

Hi Vivek,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement is starting the vendor intake for Redwood and I have a couple of asks before we kick off PO creation: 

1) Our standard payment term is Net45, but the BU (Clinical Ops) is pushing for Net30 during the first 60 days as they need faster vendor payments for implementation milestones. Can Redwood support a temporary Net30 bridge (first two invoices) and then revert to Net45?

2) We may enroll Redwood in our early-pay program (3% fee) if you can provide an early-pay enrollment form and the tax documentation (W9).

Attached: Aurora_Vendor_Setup_Form.xlsx, Aurora_W9.pdf (our internal intake).

Can you confirm the expected timing for PO acknowledgement and whether you need additional onboarding fields from our side? If helpful, we can schedule a short call with finance (CC'd) to align.

Appreciate it,
Sanjay
Senior Procurement Manager
Aurora Health

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@aurorahealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — payment timing and early-pay request

Hi Sanjay — thanks for the details and the form. 

Quick answers up front: we can pilot a Net30 bridge for the first two invoices and enroll in your early-pay program, subject to standard onboarding checks (tax, bank details, PO match). Proposed approach below: 

- Redwood will accept a temporary Net30 for the first two invoices tied to the initial PO(s). After two invoices, default terms revert to Net45 unless otherwise agreed.
- We need a signed enrollment form for the early-pay program and your payment rail (ACH instructions or third-party payment platform).
- PO acknowledgement: our intake process typically sends PO ack within 48 business hours of receiving a valid PO and completed intake form. If you need faster ack, we can flag the PO as "onboarding pilot" in our portal.

Attachments: redwood_vendor_onboard_guide.pdf (simple checklist we use).

Monica (finance ops) and David (procurement ops) are CC'd to confirm the mechanics and any DocuSign steps. Proposed next step: a 20-minute sync Thursday to finalize fields and get the DocuSign link set up. Works for you?

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@aurorahealth.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — payment timing and early-pay request

Hi all,

Adding finance ops details and the practical steps so procurement has what it needs: 

Summary of proposed mechanics (Redwood perspective):
- Default vendor term after onboarding: Net45.
- Temporary bridge: Net30 for first two invoices only. Invoices must reference the same PO number and the onboarding tag (ONB-<account>).
- Early-pay enrollment: submit Aurora's enrollment form + vendor banking + W9. There is a 3% discount for early-pay as noted; Aurora will remit early-pay funds to Redwood's account per the signed terms.

Required artifacts from Aurora to proceed (please provide):
- Completed Aurora_Vendor_Setup_Form.xlsx (we only need pages 1–2 filled).
- Signed early-pay enrollment (DocuSign) — I'll generate and send a link.
- Confirmation of ACH details (secure upload) OR third-party payment platform note.

Operational timeline we can meet:
- Day 0: procurement returns completed intake and W9.
- Day 1–2: Redwood issues PO acknowledgement (flagging onboarding pilot).
- Day 3–7: Docs processed; early-pay enrollment completed; bank validated.

I'll open the DocuSign envelope today — link below. Once signed, we can create PO and enable the Net30 bridge for the first two invoices automatically.

DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/recipient/abcde-aurora-onboard

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Finance Operations, Redwood Inference

From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@aurorahealth.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — payment timing and early-pay request

Thanks Vivek and Monica — that all looks good. I have:
- Completed the Aurora_Vendor_Setup_Form.xlsx (attached).
- Uploaded W9 to secure portal.

I clicked the DocuSign link and should have the envelope signed by end of day. Can we do a quick 15-min call tomorrow at 10am PT to confirm PO header requirements and the onboarding tag? If that works, please send an invite.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.
Sanjay

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@aurorahealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — payment timing and early-pay request

Perfect — invite sent for 2027-06-30 10:00 PT (15 minutes). Agenda: PO header fields, onboarding tag format, and confirmation of early-pay enrollment timeline.

Action items after call:
- Redwood: generate onboarding PO ack template and enable Net30 pilot tag. (Owner: David)
- Aurora: complete DocuSign envelope and confirm ACH details. (Owner: Sanjay)
- Redwood Finance: finalize early-pay terms and send final Redwood_EarlyPay_Terms_v1.pdf. (Owner: Monica)

Looking forward to the call.
Vivek
